text: Do greedy routing stretch and search radius stay flat on the {3,4,3,4} honeycomb as it grows?
description:
OP-04: routing and search on {3,4,3,4} with finite-size scaling.

Known: on {5,4}, stretch 1.002 (R-NVG-0001). On {3,4,3,4}, radius 3 at 750 and 3,000 docks (R-MMR-0001).

Unknown: the {3,4,3,4} routing at all, and either quantity at more than two sizes.

Why it matters: planned paper 2 needs it, and R-NVG-0001 is on the wrong tiling until it exists.

Scope: a small computational investigation.

Skills: network science, hyperbolic geometry, TypeScript.

Where to start: test/experiment/addressing/greedy-walkway.ts; test/experiment/associative/search-latency.ts; Kleinberg 2007. Krioukov et al. 2010.

The claims it would move: R-MMR-0001, R-NVG-0001.

Evidence named: E-NVG-0010, E-MMR-0013.
